name: str_date_parse_customer_master_hist
source_sql: SELECT hist_id AS "hist_id", TO_DATE(signup_dt DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "signup_dt_parsed", TO_DATE(last_activity_dt DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "last_activity_dt_parsed", TO_DATE(last_invoice_dt DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "last_invoice_dt_parsed", TO_DATE(last_payment_dt DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "last_payment_dt_parsed", TO_DATE(terminate_dt DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "terminate_dt_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_01 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_01_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_02 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_02_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_03 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_03_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_04 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_04_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_05 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_05_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_06 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_06_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_07 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_07_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_08 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_08_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_09 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_09_parsed", TO_DATE(udf_dt_10 DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "udf_dt_10_parsed" FROM ow_billing.customer_master_hist ORDER BY hist_id
target_sql: SELECT hist_id, signup_dt_parsed, last_activity_dt_parsed, last_invoice_dt_parsed, last_payment_dt_parsed, terminate_dt_parsed, udf_dt_01_parsed, udf_dt_02_parsed, udf_dt_03_parsed, udf_dt_04_parsed, udf_dt_05_parsed, udf_dt_06_parsed, udf_dt_07_parsed, udf_dt_08_parsed, udf_dt_09_parsed, udf_dt_10_parsed FROM ow_tp.silver.customer_master_hist ORDER BY hist_id
